name: zfmv_playback_destructor
description: zFMV_Playback::~zFMV_Playback frees the duplicated media path string and performs no other cleanup.
known_limits: VC5SP3 zfmv_playback_methods coverage now includes 0x462360 and reports zero unmasked function-byte mismatches after relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x462360 validate a non-virtual scalar destructor that loads self->mediaPathDup at offset 0x2c, calls imported free, adjusts the stack, and returns without touching the remaining POD fields.

The native destructor smoke allocates mediaPathDup, calls zFMV_Playback::Destructor to exercise the free path, then calls it again with a null mediaPathDup to verify the imported free(NULL) cleanup shape remains harmless.
